phases.title: Shared drone foundation
phases.scope: All drone types, full built-in CAD, interactive and offline analysis, electrical systems, plain engineering terrain, rain/wet operation and snow/icing, autonomy and evidence; missing experiments remain pending.

phases.title: Human and crewed aircraft
phases.scenario: 60 kg pilot is an explicit scenario assumption, not total flying mass or a biological scaling law.

status_semantics.research_record_cached: This registry caches source findings/URLs, not original provider bytes.
status_semantics.public_primary_source_reviewed: Provider documentation/metadata was read; neither acquisition nor model validity is implied.
status_semantics.external_local_originals_verified: Listed files outside this Git worktree were read and match existing committed SHA-256 pins on checked_at.
status_semantics.original_bytes_in_repository: Existing source file is named in repository_paths and hashed in local_custody; not an assertion that all upstream data are bundled.
status_semantics.cited_only: No original dataset/source-code bytes cached by this source-library task.
status_semantics.approval_required: Public report access does not grant restricted electronic data access.
status_semantics.physical_validation: No entry grants new physical acceptance, manufacturing approval or flightworthiness.

cache_policy.scope: Persist source cards and custody metadata now. Reuse checked sources; refresh when versions/terms change, links fail, or a new geometry/regime needs evidence.
before_acquisition: select exact version/file IDs and hardware/configuration
inspect raw-data terms separately from article and software licenses
record source URL, acquisition date, byte count, SHA-256, provider checksum and transformations
freeze whole-experiment calibration/holdout roles before using new observations
cache_policy.no_complete_future_cache: Future geometry-specific measurements cannot be completely acquired in advance. Large/restricted archives and new experiments remain explicitly pending.
cache_policy.sample_policy: Existing CC-BY-4.0 Quadplane BATT.csv supplies a small raw telemetry sample. No new dataset bytes were added; rights-unresolved UIUC/NASA/NeuroBEM originals were not recopied.

shared_contracts: SI units and explicit frames/time bases
parametric geometry/history versus display versus analysis meshes
environment and weather fields with provenance and validation envelopes
one authoritative plant and simulation clock per run
interactive/offline solver jobs using the same versioned project snapshot
uncertainty, independent holdouts, measured/derived/simulated channel labels and immutable evidence receipts

P0A-008 diagnosis: the single M24 CT sign disagreement (6018 RPM, J=0.671, measured CT -0.0001 = -1 count of the 4-decimal source format vs predicted +0.000218) is a resolution-limited zero-crossing straddle (measured crossing J~0.6705 vs model ~0.6721), not a sign-convention or unit defect; see docs/acceptance/P0A-008.md.

access.acquisition: Existing static source is in data/benchmarks/uiuc; six axial originals beside repository match campaign pins. Resolve raw redistribution terms before bundling more.
